m.d: A zip is a sound made by a small object.
A zip is a short form of zipper.
m.e: Is the zip on your coat working.

m.d: If something zips somewhere, it move there quickly.
m.e: The birds zip from tree to tree.

m.d: If you zip something up, you close its zipper.
m.e: Zip up your coat before going outside.

m.d: A zipper is a device used to join two pieces of cloth for a short amount of time.
A zing is a short high-pitched humming sound, it is similar to those made by a bullet or vibrating string.
A zing is a witty insult or derogatory remark.
If something zings, it moves very quickly.
If you zing a person, you attack or criticize them with a remark.
Zinc is a type of metal, (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30 on the periodic table.
If you zinc something, you cover it with zinc.
